proof_body:
by
  intro a L he ho
  rw [Metric.tendsto_atTop] at he ho ⊢
  intro ε hε
  obtain ⟨N₁, h₁⟩ := he ε hε
  obtain ⟨N₂, h₂⟩ := ho ε hε
  refine ⟨2 * N₁ + 2 * N₂ + 1, fun n hn => ?_⟩
  rcases Nat.even_or_odd' n with ⟨k, rfl | rfl⟩
  · exact h₁ k (by omega)
  · exact h₂ k (by omega)
target_source: ∀ (a : ℕ → ℝ) (L : ℝ), Filter.Tendsto (fun n => a (2 * n)) Filter.atTop (nhds L) → Filter.Tendsto (fun n => a (2 * n + 1)) Filter.atTop (nhds L) → Filter.Tendsto a Filter.atTop (nhds L)
